Please decide which statements are true.

## The ten decisions that unblock the most

| # | Ask | From | Reference |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Which phone numbers are official, what is each used for, and does each office have its own public number? | CEO / management | Q-CEO-04 |
| 2 | Where the website and the company profile or brochure disagree, which is correct? | CEO / management | Q-CEO-15 |
| 3 | Approve the publication order (manned guarding, CCTV and electric fencing, with Nairobi and Nakuru; then the rest, with Rongo), and say whether new pages may reuse the existing layout and be linked from the homepage and footer. | CEO / management | Q-CEO-16 |
| 4 | Is there an approved privacy notice and data-protection position for the enquiry form and for any analytics? | Compliance / legal | Q-LEG-05 |
| 5 | Which statements in the two PDFs are true and may stay public, and which must be corrected or withdrawn? | Compliance / legal | Q-LEG-07 |
| 6 | Is there a Search Console property for www.jolusecurity.com, and who administers it? | Marketing / IT | Q-MKT-02 |
| 7 | Is analytics (GA4) set up, and do quote-form, call and WhatsApp events work? | Marketing / IT | Q-MKT-03 |
| 8 | Share a crawl or redirect check of the live site: does the bare domain redirect to www, is HTTPS enforced, and which URLs exist today (including any /locations or /services pages)? | Marketing / IT | Q-MKT-05 |
| 9 | Who reviews each page for original text, and do you accept the proposed rule that no more than 30 per cent of sentences may be shared between location pages? | Marketing / IT | Q-MKT-11 |
| 10 | Complete the coverage table: for each of the seven services, which office delivers it and in which counties and towns? | Security operations | Q-OPS-01 |

## What happens next

1. Management answers the questionnaire, by role, starting with the questions above.
2. Supplied documents are recorded against the register; an item becomes VERIFIED only when independent evidence is on file.
3. Approved claims are recorded in the claims registry.
4. Pages are written in the order management approves, then each receives a signed approval to publish.
